renderer.method: Fresh repository DOCX matched against every prepared package member; canonical PDF retained unchanged; CI Poppler PNG rendering at 2000 px.

canonical_renderer.method: Primary document runtime DOCX build and canonical render_docx.py --emit_pdf; complete PDF prepared locally and retained unchanged for CI page rendering and independent visual approval.

canonical_source_provenance.reason: LibreOffice 24.2.7.2 on CI omitted table 16 rows 3-7 in both conversion attempts. The canonical renderer preserves the complete ordered content; CI must verify source and DOCX-member identity, rerun the same full content guard and render this exact PDF for page-by-page review. No visual approval is implied by this input manifest.

limitations: A successful conversion and page count do not approve visual layout. Every final page requires a separate visual review.
